Trading Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international trading professionals. Alpha reflects his vision: language learning as strategic capability — a multiplier of careers, execution, and entire trading relationships.

Designed for the traders, portfolio managers, brokers, and financial analysts reshaping global markets — Alpha is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to lead in the fastest-moving, most technically demanding industry of our time.
